description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Talent Mode I (Prishe)] and [(Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Talent Mode I (Prishe)
description.text: Lightning and Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning and Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Lightning and Ice abilities after using 1/2/3+ Lightning or Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Awoken Talent Mode II (Prishe)] and [Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning) v2]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Talent Mode II (Prishe)
description.text: Lightning and Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Lightning and Ice abilities, grants [Critical Damage +50% 3] to the user after using Lightning or Ice abilities if 0-3 FF11 allies are alive, grants [Critical Damage +50% (15s)] to all allies after using Lightning or Ice abilities if 4+ FF11 allies are alive, grants [Quick Cast 3] to the user after using Lightning or Ice abilities if 4+ FF11 allies are alive

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 3
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Critical Damage +50% (15s)
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Lightning) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: (Ice/Lightning) Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities deal 5% more damage
